text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Race development—course selection— and 
then—acceleration!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I can read it...! From this elevated 
vantage point, I can even read the 
'King's' thoughts. And what's more—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I get where the "free-spirited" types are 
coming from, too. I lean that way myself, 
after all.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey! Hold the hell up!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The one to surpass gold and venture beyond 
is none other than Rulership. And "us"—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's the Rulership Squad (provisional)!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: We did it...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
............ ...They got... the better of 
us.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, we won that one fair and square with 
our strategy!
Yeah, that was a tactical victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Crossing the finish line in first is 
Rulership!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A brilliant strategy! She delivered a 
truly magnificent race performance."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I gave it my all... 
as a board gamer...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I've completely read their moves, and 
every random fluctuation..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I beat Orfe-san... I beat Golshi-san... 
And every other player, too..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, gaming is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This is so much fun...! I'm having the 
time of my life, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You look so happy, Ruler-senpai! It really 
feels like the culmination of everything!

"I won't forget. This collection of 
replays spun together with Rulership. 
And—"

"This book will surely become a bible for 
junior students who aspire to Rulership."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. Just as expected—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And so you have. You two have become... a 
formidable force to be reckoned with.
choice_data_list: Journey... what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.text:
I'd always wondered. Why was Dream Journey 
marking Rulership so closely?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...There are forms of strength that last 
only a single generation, and those that 
do not.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And we are pursuing the latter as well. 
Strength as a "collective." And at the 
center of that is...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Big Sis—namely, Stay Gold.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Rulership-san isn't like that person. 
However... they both possess that 
captivating charisma capable of gathering 
a following.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Our scale as a group may be small, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see them as rivals on pretty much equal 
footing.

Competing as a herd... It seems Dream 
Journey feared Rulership's magnetic 
leadership.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I thought I heard someone calling 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, there he is! The Shadow Chief!

—Stay Gold. A travel-loving Umamusume said 
to keep the likes of Orfevre in line.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Rulership, huh... She's different from me, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't she sound like a wild one? Feels 
like she's gonna turn everything upside 
down!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
By all means, do as you please and make 
the Twinkle Series exciting. After all...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A predictable journey is a boring one, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ruler-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You were incredible, Ruler.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for all your hard work 
this year, Ruler-san.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you guys too. Though I was the one 
who won today—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I will accept a rematch anytime from next 
year onward. Because I am—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Because I love competing against you all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Traaaiineer~, man, this is the best! This 
game rocks!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It's a masterpiece, a great game, and a 
delightfully silly game all in one—surely 
it's got Game of the Year in the bag, 
right?!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really was the best.
Yeah, it really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though... it probably wouldn't 
have been half as fun playing solo.”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This game is... definitely way more fun in 
co-op! So, you know...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's hang out again, okay? From now on, 
too!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's play forever and ever!
Yeah, let's play forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, that's the spirit! I knew 
choosing you was the right call, it has to 
be you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No slipping away early from here on out 
either, got it!
Reality isn't a game. Even so—

How wonderful it would be if one could 
live reality like a game. Rulership seized 
just such an existence for himself.
And then—some days later.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai, what are you going to do 
next? If you're going to "rule the era"...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is it our turn next!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. Or so I'd like to say, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
After all, I have not yet claimed total 
control over the present. There is still 
uncharted territory remaining on the 
board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dubai is the only country where my Trainer 
and I were able to leave our mark. It's 
still far too incomplete to entrust to 
those who follow.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And with that said, Trainer... let us head 
off.

Rulership's eyes gleam sharply. A new 
ambition was burning in her gaze.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The next step toward world domination. 
First, the neighboring cities. In other 
words—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hong Kong!!

Before becoming the ruler of all eras, 
first I'll aim to become the "Ruler of the 
World"—

Rulership boldly advances her piece. This 
game will never end.
